text:
Alex P.: Quick postmortem follow-up thread for the KV-cache memory/fragmentation OOM. We need a tight action tracker with owners, blockers, and dates. Please claim items.

Maria K.: I'll run deeper profiling across tenants and capture jemalloc stats + periodic heapdumps. Plan: perftest that simulates bursty writes + KV hot keys. Target preliminary report by Wed EOD.

Samir: I'll investigate fragmentation and allocator misconfig. Intend to test jemalloc background defrag, tweak arenas, and inspect mmap growth. ETA: next Tue.

Jenna: I'll own quick mitigations: implement soft per-shard memory caps, throttling at 70% and a rolling restart playbook. Canary policy ready Mon.

Theo: Adding a note on recurring pattern: we've seen similar small spikes in Mar and Apr incidents; might be correlated with bulk-import job on staging. I'll dig through logs and link S3 traces.

Alex P.: Action: add tenant quotas as a short-term safety net. Owner?

Jenna: I'll add tenant quota enforcement config (low-risk). Need infra hook to enforce per-tenant limits.

InfraBot: Incident reference: <https://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0421>  deploys and alert history included.

Maria K.: Created ticket RT-4200 (profiling + heapdumps). Staging run scheduled 02:00 UTC tonight.

Samir: Created RT-4207 (allocator tuning + fragmentation). Need approval to restart 2 staging canaries between 03:00-04:00 UTC. @Alex P.

Alex P.: Approved.

Jenna: Created RT-4211 (soft-limits + throttling + restart playbook). Linked runbooks and rollback steps.

Maria K.: Early finding from the first heapdump: tenant-77 has multiple large pinned buffers from the replication path. Captured allocation stacks, uploading to RT-4200.

Samir: That points to a retention/leak in the replication aggregator. I'll instrument that path and add jemalloc profiling.

Theo: I found a recurring cron job that runs bulk-upserts every weekend; matches pattern of growth. Filing analysis ticket TLOG-98.

Alex P.: Priorities: 1) Short-term safety (quotas/throttles), 2) Profiling to identify root cause, 3) Allocator tuning, 4) Eviction + heuristics.

Maria K.: Quick ask: need longer heapdump retention on staging (~48h) and access to per-tenant metrics.

Alex P.: Granting access. Who can take ownership of eviction heuristics long-term?

Samir: I'll sketch eviction improvements but want product input on correctness.

Jenna: Ops will prototype time-based TTL defaults and soft-LRU tweaks.

InfraBot: Weekly remediation sync Fri 09:00 UTC. Please post brief updates before the sync.

Alex P.: Pls drop short status here by Thu noon.

Maria K.: RT-4200: initial profiling uploaded; key notes: replication aggregator holds 3x expected buffers under heavy load.

Samir: RT-4207: ran jemalloc bg-defrag test on canary, fragmentation decreased 18% but throughput degraded 6% under CPU pressure. Detailed results in the ticket.

Jenna: RT-4211: soft-limits roll out to canary, throttling triggered once on canary, prevented OOM and did not impact tail latency.

Alex P.: Great progress. Closing loop: please add one-line next steps in your tickets and tag me.

Maria K.: Will do.

Samir: Will follow up with PR for arena tuning.
